title: Parallel Cloud Background Agents for Multi-Branch Feature Delivery
oneLiner: Cursor Background Agents spin up isolated remote environments connected to GitHub to implement features, run test suites, and open pull requests in parallel while developers work locally.
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
whatItDoes: Cursor Background Agents spin up isolated remote environments connected to GitHub to implement features, run test suites, and open pull requests in parallel while developers work locally.
steps: Connect GitHub repo and configure environment snapshot
Spawn agent task from IDE or Slack
Review remote branch diff and PR.
configSnippet: "Implement rate-limiting middleware on the /api/v1 routes and add integration tests in a new branch."
limitations: Usage incurs compute and token charges
requires reproducible environment setup scripts for remote containers.
